payload.title: FR-256 client halves: subscribeObject resolves on server registration (Swift/Kotlin/web)
payload.description: The FR-256 server race is fixed; the defense-in-depth client halves remain: FrickSyncSocket.subscribeObject (Swift packages/swift, Kotlin apps/android, web packages/core) should resolve on server registration (a Subscribe ack), not on frame send. Needs a Subscribe-ack on the wire + client await. Relates to FR-256.
